alex_infra: Heads-up — we've got repeated gRPC stalls on apac-1 GPU pods between node-a{22} and node-b{07}. Observed during large model stream starts, ~10-20s pauses, then resume.

maria_net: Seen it. Packet traces show fragments but no reassembly completing. looks like MTU mismatch on some node egress paths.

kevin_sre: What changed in apac rollover? Any CNI or host NIC config flips?

maria_net: We rolled a Cilium policy update and enabled SR-IOV passthrough on a subset of hosts last night. Encapsulation + SR-IOV likely produced different effective MTU.

jia_gpu: Symptoms: GPU job logs show gRPC stream stuck waiting for more tokens, CPU fine, GPUs still compute. This maps to long pauses in logs.

alex_infra: tcpdump from node-a shows lots of 1500B UDP/GSO fragments hitting node-b which expects 9000. ICMP frag-needed messages are not making it back (ICMP blackhole?).

maria_net: Confirmed: firewall on the Edge interconnect drops ICMP type 3 code 4. PMTU discovery effectively broken.

kevin_sre: Short-term mitigation suggestion: clamp MSS on egress at nodes so TCP doesn't try to send > path MTU. Command: `iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu` — deployable as a DaemonSet.

jia_gpu: Can we gate that only on nodes with SR-IOV? We don't want extra iptables churn everywhere.

maria_net: We can label sr-iov nodes and have the DaemonSet nodeSelector. Also add sysctl `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` as a stop-gap to force probing when blackhole detected.

alex_infra: Plan: 1) Roll out MSS-clamp DaemonSet to labeled SR-IOV nodes in apac-1 (canary 2 nodes) 2) Enable tcp_mtu_probing=1 on canary 3) Revert Cilium SR-IOV patch if stable not achieved 4) Longer term: update edge firewall to allow ICMP frag-needed.

kevin_sre: I'll prepare the DaemonSet manifest. quick snippet: `kind: DaemonSet\nmetadata: name: mss-clamp\nspec: template: spec: nodeSelector: { "node.kubernetes.io/sr-iov": "true" } containers: - name: iptables-init image: busybox command: ["/bin/sh","-c","iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu"]`

deploy-bot: hotfix/mss-clamp deployed to apac-1 canary nodes (node-07, node-22).

ops-bot: monitoring alert suppressed for gRPC pause flapping during rollout window (30m).

maria_net: After canary: we saw reduced gRPC stalls on patched nodes within 3 mins. Path MTU still needs fixing but MSS clamp reduced stalls by ~85%.

alex_infra: Good. Raise ticket to change firewall ACLs to allow ICMP frag-needed from our node subnets back to source. Also add an e2e test: start streaming > 50k token job across nodes that have different MTU to catch regressions.

jia_gpu: Noted. I'll also add a guard in the inference runtime to fall back to smaller chunk sizes when retransmit stall detected (simple backoff + smaller frame). Helps until network fully fixed.

kevin_sre: Will schedule a full apac-1 remediation (edge ACL + CNI SR-IOV review) for tomorrow.

alex_infra: Thanks all. Update this thread with remediation PRs/links. :thumbsup:
